headline: Peruvian sol opens lower against US dollar following US election results
summary: The exchange rate for the US dollar in Peru opened lower at S/3.450 in the foreign exchange market compared to S/3.462 previously, marking an approximate 0.3% drop.
why: Foreign exchange movements reflect shifts in global currency demand and emerging market risk sentiment following major geopolitical events.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Peruvian Sol
impacts.why: The exchange rate dropped by approximately 0.3% following election results.
